verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a document-intelligence platform, but no evidence shows Datalab accepting natural-language commands to drive it. Its documented interfaces are the SDK, a flag-based CLI, REST endpoints driven by JSON schemas, and the Forge upload UI. Published agent processors and auto-generated extraction schemas are related features, not natural-language control of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
